content.title: Classic FM
content.text: Acclaimed American soprano Rainelle Krause has died at the age of 37.Krause made her Metropolitan Opera debut three months ago as the Queen of the Night in Mozart’s ‘The Magic Flute’, and had a Santa Fe Opera engagement scheduled for this year. As well as her soaring voice, the coloratura soprano was known for combining her singing with arial acrobatics.Chris MilamA specific cause of death has not been publicly disclosed. Her family has stated only that she experienced a brief hospitalization, and that her passing was sudden and unexpected.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​ΛΕΥΤΕΡΗΣ ΟΡΦΑΝΙΔΗΣDo not know the lady, neither I ever heard her singing, nevertheless I am sorry to hear this news for such a young talented soprano.75Kristy Lynn Newark Gossett Thinking of her husband and family. Sad that the beautiful talented voice Rainelle shared is gone. Her singing with incredible power while performing high aerials on silks was surreal. She said singing upside down eased the production of sound when her body was not working against gravity. Fly high without tethers lovely lady.Ruby HeadOh beautiful girl with a beautiful voice! You will be missed. My heart goes out to all who loved her."May flights of angels sing thee to thy rest, sweet princess!" ~ William ShakespeareCJ JonasenOh, my! Some angels don't get to spend too much time among us, so they?Jason TuhoroDoes Ms Krause have any recordings out, and if so, where?5Sara LegerSorry for her family’s loss and the loss to the opera community. She was extremely talented and I will miss hearing her in other productions3284Sylvie JupinetEn français c'est La Flûte enchantée, pas La Flûte magique.14
